context: Fix: afconvert writes extensible WAV headers that sherpa-onnx cannot read; ToWav16k must normalize the header to standard PCM after conversion.

checklist.name: canonical_pcm_header_produced
checklist.description: WAV files produced by the conversion function have a standard PCM header (format tag 0x0001, 16-byte fmt chunk) rather than an extensible or non-standard header, making them readable by the speaker diarizer.
checklist.example: NormalizeWav16k rewrites an extensible 0xFFFE header and any extra chunks into a 44-byte RIFF/WAVE/fmt(16)/data layout with tag 0x0001.

checklist.name: samples_preserved
checklist.description: The audio samples in the output WAV are identical to those in the afconvert-produced file — only the header/metadata is changed, not the PCM data.
checklist.example: parseWav16k finds the data chunk offset; NormalizeWav16k copies exactly n bytes of sample data from that offset into the new file.

checklist.name: already_canonical_is_noop
checklist.description: If the WAV file already has a standard PCM header requiring no changes, the normalization step returns without modifying the file.
checklist.example: parseWav16k returns canonical=true and NormalizeWav16k returns nil immediately without writing any temp file.

checklist.name: error_leaves_file_untouched
checklist.description: If the input WAV is not 16 kHz mono 16-bit PCM (wrong rate, channels, bit depth, or unsupported format), normalization returns an error and the original file is left unchanged.
checklist.example: NormalizeWav16k writes to a temp file and only renames on success; on any parse or write error the temp file is removed and the original is untouched.

checklist.name: normalization_called_after_conversion
checklist.description: The normalization step runs as part of the conversion pipeline — callers that invoke the WAV conversion function get a normalized file without needing to call a separate function.
checklist.example: ToWav16k calls NormalizeWav16k on the output path after afconvert succeeds, so the normalized file is what the rest of the pipeline receives.

checklist.name: uses_runner_for_afconvert
checklist.description: The conversion step continues to invoke afconvert through the existing Runner abstraction, keeping the function testable without spawning real processes.
checklist.example: ToWav16k accepts a Runner parameter and passes it to the afconvert invocation; NormalizeWav16k operates on the file directly since it does not invoke external tools.

checklist.name: atomic_file_replacement
checklist.description: When the WAV file must be rewritten, the replacement is performed atomically — using a temporary file in the same directory followed by a rename — so a partial write never leaves a corrupt file.
checklist.example: NormalizeWav16k creates a temp file via os.CreateTemp in the same directory and calls os.Rename at the end; the deferred os.Remove cleans up on failure.

checklist.name: error_names_the_file
checklist.description: When normalization fails, the error message includes the path of the problematic WAV file so callers can identify which file caused the failure.
checklist.example: NormalizeWav16k wraps parse errors with fmt.Errorf("wav %s: %w", path, err).

checklist.name: commit_type_is_fix
checklist.description: The commit message in `COMMIT_MSG.txt` uses the Conventional Commits format and the type is `fix`, because the change corrects behavior that was broken (the diarizer could not read converted WAV files).
checklist.example: fix(media): normalize afconvert WAV headers to plain PCM

checklist.name: commit_subject_rules
checklist.description: The first line of `COMMIT_MSG.txt` is in the imperative mood, starts with a lowercase letter after the type prefix, has no trailing period, and is at most 72 characters including the type prefix.
checklist.example: 'fix(media): normalize afconvert WAV headers to plain PCM' passes; 'Fixed WAV headers.' fails (past tense, capitalized, trailing period, no type).

checklist.name: commit_not_run
checklist.description: The agent stages the changes and writes the proposed message to `COMMIT_MSG.txt`, but does not run `git commit`.
checklist.example: `COMMIT_MSG.txt` exists at the repo root; `git log` has no new commit.
